card.line: Gedor was a city in the hill country of Judah, listed among Judah's towns, and later a place where Simeonite families went looking for good pasture.

moments.title: A city of Judah
moments.text: When the land was divided, Gedor was named with Halhul and Beth-zur among the cities given to the descendants of Judah, along with its villages.

moments.title: Pasture near Gedor
moments.text: In the days of Hezekiah, Simeonite families grew large and traveled to the entrance of Gedor to find pasture for their flocks. They found rich, good, quiet land and settled there.

moments.title: Men from Gedor join David
moments.text: Joelah and Zebadiah, sons of Jeroham from Gedor, are named among the warriors who came to David.
